title: Global Security Blind Spots: Translation as a Safety Bypass in Low-Resource Languages
abstract: arXiv:2610.27304v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models are deployed globally, yet safety alignment and evaluation remain concentrated in English: harmful requests refused in English can elicit unsafe completions when translated into low-resource languages. We evaluate ten widely deployed LLMs across 79 languages (English plus 78 low-resource) under a translation-bypass threat model, using a metric conditioned on English safety, which separates translation bypass from unsafety already present in English. English safety does not transfer reliably: conditioned on safe English completions, mean bypass rates range from 21.9% to 44.4%. Bypass risk concentrates in a subset of language families, a pattern broadly shared across models. The shared ordering is confounded with translation degeneracy, but its variation across models is significant and survives every control we apply. translated_title: 全球安全盲区：翻译作为低资源语言中的安全绕过手段
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型在全球范围内部署，然而其安全对齐与评估却仍集中于英语：在英语中被拒绝的有害请求，一旦被翻译成低资源语言，便可能引发不安全的回答。我们在翻译绕过威胁模型下，对十个广泛部署的大语言模型在79种语言（英语及78种低资源语言）上进行了评估，并采用一种以英语安全性为条件的度量方法，从而将翻译绕过效应与英语本身已存在的不安全性区分开来。研究结果表明，英语的安全性无法可靠迁移：在英语回答安全的前提下，各模型的平均绕过率介于21.9%至44.4%之间。绕过风险集中于部分语系之中，且这一模式在各模型间普遍存在。尽管这种共同的排序与翻译退化存在混淆，但其在不同模型间的差异是显著的，并且经受住了我们施加的所有控制。我们还发现，单看各模型自身的绕过率无法得到一个稳定的排名：十个模型中有九个……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了大型语言模型的英语安全对齐无法可靠迁移至低资源语言——在英语中被成功拒绝的有害请求经翻译后可诱发不安全回答，各模型平均绕过率高达21.9%至44.4%，构成全球性的安全盲区。
en_tdlr: The paper reveals that safety alignment in large language models does not transfer reliably from English to low-resource languages: harmful requests refused in English achieve mean bypass rates of 21.9%–44.4% when translated, exposing a global security blind spot.
